title: Venue Candidates
description: VERIFY-stage B-path artifact. Output of venue-selector when no target venue is given. Emits a ranked list of candidate venues for the director to choose from. NO selected/chosen/picked/director_* field exists: the schema is additionalProperties:false, making an auto-pick structurally impossible. The director picks via the /venue-pick human gate.

candidates.description: Ranked list of candidate venues. Each candidate carries the nomination rationale and the deadliest reject-trigger for this work. The director picks one via /venue-pick; the model never self-selects.

venue_id.description: Venue name or abbreviation (e.g. NeurIPS, MICCAI, TPAMI). Non-empty.

tier.description: Venue tier: conf = top ML conference; med = medical imaging venue; journal = archival journal.

paper_type.description: Paper type classification for this work at this venue.

hit_reason.description: Why this venue is a strong match for the work (topic, strength, open-problem alignment). Non-empty.

deadliest_reject_trigger.description: The single most likely reject-trigger this work faces at this venue. Non-empty.

evidence_ref.description: Evidence pointers grounding the nomination (anti-slop). At least one required; each must be non-blank.

rank.description: Optional rank (1 = top recommendation). Present when venue-selector can rank candidates.
